scientific_integrity: The inclusion is proved locally at every prime divisor. The counting asymptotic follows from an explicit Euler-product identity and the classical Selberg--Delange theorem with exponent one half; finite computations are used only as regression checks.
scientific_limitations: The theorem gives a sufficient squarefree subfamily and a lower bound for Dris's set; it does not determine the density of the full set and is compatible with the conjectured density zero.
title: A squarefree \(2\bmod 3\) subfamily in Dris's GCD set
